text:
eli: Quick heads-up: someone left the espresso grounds bin open and the beans spilled a bit this morning. tiny cleanup but recurring. :coffee:
nora: oof sorry — that was me, rushed. i'll vacuum it up later.
sam: maybe we add a simple 'close/clean' sticker on the grinder? visual cue.
viv: also can we standardize communal snacks payment? i keep forgetting cash. could we just do a shared stripe link?
ops-bot: pantry-funds: balance $4.20. low items flagged: coffee beans, oatmilk. Create one-off shopping request? reply 'ops: shop' or 'ops: hold'.
eli: ops: shop
nora: i'll bring a roll of stickers and a tiny dustpan. also can someone volunteer to clear the grounds after each Friday?
sam: happy to rotate. i can take Fridays this month.
viv: stripe link is fine by me if others want digital. coin jar still fine for those who prefer cash.
ops-bot: shopping ticket #478 created: coffee beans (medium roast), oatmilk (1), airtight grounds bin.
eli: thank you. tiny ask: if you take the last of something, please ping #lunch-plans or put a note on the whiteboard so someone can restock. small wins.
viv: agreed. i'll DM finance to add $20 to pantry funds this week.
nora: cleaned the spill + put lid back on 44d
sam: sticker placed on grinder: 'close + brush after use' :label:
eli: perfect. coffee harmony restored. :coffee:
